chatgpt.text:
If I lived in Shawnee, I’d call these first:

- **E & J Auto LLC** — Best all-around “family car” shop. Strong review volume **4.8/446**, and they handle maintenance, engine, A/C, electrical, and exhaust work. Good pick when you don’t know exactly what’s wrong. ([eandjautocare.com](https://eandjautocare.com/reviews/))  
- **Williams Transmission & Air Conditioner Service** — My choice for transmission or A/C issues. It’s ASE/NAPA affiliated, offers a 24-month/24,000-mile NAPA warranty, shuttle/night drop, and has **4.9/81 verified CARFAX reviews**. ([williamstransmission.net](https://www.williamstransmission.net/))  
- **Shawnee Pittstop** — Best for quick oil changes and routine maintenance; CARFAX shows **4.9 with 531 verified reviews** and lots of local use. ([carfax.com](https://www.carfax.com/Auto-Repair-Shawnee-OK_c22519))  
- **Fred’s Tire & Battery — Harrison** — Best for tires, batteries, rotations, alignment/steering-suspension basics; **4.8 with 273+ verified reviews**. ([carfax.com](https://www.carfax.com/Auto-Repair-Shawnee-OK_c22519))  
- **Randy’s Tire & Alignment / Kasterke’s** — Good specialist for tires, alignment, suspension; CARFAX lists **4.9/53 verified reviews**. ([carfax.com](https://www.carfax.com/Auto-Repair-Shawnee-OK_c22519))

gemini.text:
As a homeowner, I look for mechanics the same way I look for home contractors: honesty, fair pricing, and standing behind their work. Here are the top local shops in Shawnee I’d recommend:

1. **Christian Brothers Automotive**: Best overall for customer service and transparency. They send a digital inspection with photos directly to your phone before starting any work, so you never feel upsold. Plus, they offer a 3-year/36,000-mile warranty and a complimentary shuttle service. 

2. **Dunlap Tire & Auto**: A long-standing local staple. They are fantastic for routine maintenance, brakes, suspension, and tires. The staff is down-to-earth, local, and known for giving honest "you need this now, but this can wait" advice.

3. **Direct Tire & Auto**: Great if you need a quick turnaround and competitive labor rates. They handle everything from alignments to major engine diagnostics without playing games with the bill. 

*Homeowner tip:* Call ahead to book an appointment with Dunlap or Christian Brothers, as their trustworthy reputation keeps their bays busy.
